# 2. Infrastructure and Compliance

Purpose: make production services safe, configured, reviewable, and legally supportable.

## Final steps

- [ ] Rotate the exposed Anthropic key; revoke the old value. (2026-10-06: OpenAI and Groq
  dropped entirely — Arete is Anthropic-only now, so there is nothing to rotate for those two.)
- [x] Build and deploy the Arete Anthropic proxy (`supabase/functions/arete-proxy`, built 2026-10-06;
  checked 2026-10-08: ACTIVE, version 2, JWT verification on). `ARETE_ANTHROPIC_PROXY_URL` in
  `Config.xconfig` points at it.
- [ ] Make Release Arete answer. At the 2026-10-08 audit a signed-in Release user got no reply: the
  client sent only the empty static bearer token, not the user's Supabase JWT; the quota migration
  `supabase/migrations/20261005120000_arete_proxy_usage.sql` was not applied in production (no
  `arete_consume_proxy_quota`, no `arete_proxy_usage`); and the proxy rejected system prompts over
  20,000 characters. The code side is section 10, item 3 of `Paths/final_revisions.md`. Owner steps:
  apply the migration, set or confirm the function secret (`supabase secrets set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...`),
  deploy the updated function (`supabase functions deploy arete-proxy`; the live version 2 still has the
  20,000-character cap), then rotate the key (item above).
  2026-10-08: the migration is applied (with `20261008220000_arete_proxy_quota_revoke_anon.sql`) and
  `arete-proxy` version 3 is deployed. The upstream request was answered by `claude-sonnet-5-5`,
  callers without a user session get 401, and the quota refuses past its limit. Left: rotate the key,
  then run RS-09 on a Release build.
- [x] Mapbox removed entirely (2026-10-06): unused SDK, package dependency, access token, and
  Terms disclosure all deleted — nothing left to restrict or rotate.
- [ ] Publish Privacy Policy and Terms pages, then wire final URLs into the app and App Store
  metadata.
  (2026-10-08: the paths-web terms, privacy, support and invite pages are still placeholders.
  The Terms page must mirror the in-app Terms, including 15.1: deleting the account does not
  cancel a subscription bought through Apple.)
- [ ] Verify production Supabase migrations, row-level security, authentication settings, and
  account deletion against staging before production deployment. (2026-10-06: a security-hardening
  migration — storage bucket read scoped to authenticated, levels/badges/user_badges read policies,
  15 functions pinned to search_path=public — is written at
  `supabase/migrations/20261006040000_security_hardening_pass.sql` but was declined when applying
  via automation; apply it manually and re-run the Supabase advisors to confirm.)
- [x] Review privacy manifest against the final feature scope (2026-10-06): added SystemBootTime
  required-reason declaration, fixed 3 invalid collected-data-type identifiers, added 1C8F.1 for
  app-group UserDefaults, added manifests to the Watch and Widget targets, set
  ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption. Permission prompts and third-party disclosures still need a pass
  against final scope; retention/export behavior not reviewed.
- [ ] Keep Twilio delivery disabled. Do not purchase, deploy, or send until provider verification,
  consent design, abuse controls, budget, and launch-country compliance are approved.
